src/main/java/Checksum.java: class Checksum { public static int sumMod256(byte[] data); }. Semantics: sums every provided byte as unsigned (b & 0xFF), returns sum % 256. No side effects.

src/main/java/ZigZag.java: class ZigZag { public static int[][] traversal(int size, boolean[][] reserved); }. Semantics: validates reserved is size x size. Two-pass bounded row-serpentine algorithm: First pass counts only unreserved cells with int count = 0; then literally allocates int[][] result = new int[count][2];. Second pass: for (int row = 0; row < size; row++) { if (row % 2 == 0) iterate col 0..size-1; else iterate col size-1..0; append coordinates only when !reserved[row][col]; }. No while loops, MUST NOT allocate new int[size * size][2], MUST NOT use index < size * size termination, and MUST NOT emit placeholder zeros. Consumers (encode/decode) use returned coordinates directly without re-filtering.

src/main/java/FinderPattern.java: class FinderPattern { public static boolean[][] reservedMask(int size); public static void place(QRMatrix matrix); public static void verify(QRMatrix matrix); }. Semantics: Defines and enforces exactly three 7x7 finder squares at top-left, top-right, and bottom-left. reservedMask marks those cells true; throws IllegalArgumentException if size is even or < 21. place sets those cells to true in the given matrix. verify ensures those cells are true and reserved pattern matches exactly; throws IllegalArgumentException on mismatch.

src/main/java/TextEncoder.java: class TextEncoder { public static byte[] encodePayload(String text); public static String decodePayload(byte[] frame); public static boolean[] bytesToBits(byte[] bytes); public static byte[] bitsToBytes(boolean[] bits); }. Semantics:
- encodePayload: UTF-8 encodes text; builds frame [lenHi, lenLo, payload..., checksum]; computes checksum ONLY over the prefix (two length bytes plus payload) via java.util.Arrays.copyOf(frame, frame.length - 1) and Checksum.sumMod256; writes checksum as final byte; never computes over the complete frame.
- decodePayload: requires frame length == 2 + L + 1; validates checksum using the same prefix-only java.util.Arrays.copyOf(frame, frame.length - 1) and compares to (frame[frame.length - 1] & 0xFF); decodes payload as strict UTF-8 and returns String. Throws IllegalArgumentException on length mismatch or checksum mismatch, and CharacterCodingException-derived errors are wrapped or rethrown as IllegalArgumentException.
- bytesToBits: emits exactly eight MSB-first bits per byte using the literal statement bits[i * 8 + bit] = (bytes[i] & (1 << (7 - bit))) != 0;.
- bitsToBytes: accepts any non-null bit array length (including 0 and non-multiples of 8). It must literally allocate byte[] result = new byte[(bits.length + 7) / 8]; and set each true bit with result[i / 8] |= (byte) (1 << (7 - (i % 8)));. No modulo-length rejection, exceptions, assertions, early returns, or truncation if bits.length % 8 != 0.
